```{r}
library(data.table)

fst_hot_amb <- fread("/Users/alexmacadam/Desktop/pbs/fst_north_hot_vs_amb.weir.fst")
fst_hot_pre <- fread("/Users/alexmacadam/Desktop/pbs/fst_north_hot_vs_pre.weir.fst")
fst_amb_pre <- fread("/Users/alexmacadam/Desktop/pbs/fst_north_amb_vs_pre.weir.fst")

# Standardise CHROM col name if needed
if ("#CHROM" %in% names(fst_hot_amb)) {
  setnames(fst_hot_amb, "#CHROM", "CHROM")
  setnames(fst_hot_pre, "#CHROM", "CHROM")
  setnames(fst_amb_pre, "#CHROM", "CHROM")
}

# Keep just what we need and rename Fst columns
fst_hot_amb <- fst_hot_amb[, .(
  CHROM, POS,
  Fst_hot_amb = WEIR_AND_COCKERHAM_FST
)]

fst_hot_pre <- fst_hot_pre[, .(
  CHROM, POS,
  Fst_hot_pre = WEIR_AND_COCKERHAM_FST
)]

fst_amb_pre <- fst_amb_pre[, .(
  CHROM, POS,
  Fst_amb_pre = WEIR_AND_COCKERHAM_FST
)]

pbs_north <- merge(fst_hot_amb, fst_hot_pre,
                   by = c("CHROM", "POS"), all = FALSE)
pbs_north <- merge(pbs_north, fst_amb_pre,
                   by = c("CHROM", "POS"), all = FALSE)

# Clamp negatives / NAs to 0
pbs_north[is.na(Fst_hot_amb) | Fst_hot_amb < 0, Fst_hot_amb := 0]
pbs_north[is.na(Fst_hot_pre) | Fst_hot_pre < 0, Fst_hot_pre := 0]
pbs_north[is.na(Fst_amb_pre) | Fst_amb_pre < 0, Fst_amb_pre := 0]

# Calculate T and PBS in place
pbs_north[, T_hot_amb := -log(1 - Fst_hot_amb)]
pbs_north[, T_hot_pre := -log(1 - Fst_hot_pre)]
pbs_north[, T_amb_pre := -log(1 - Fst_amb_pre)]

pbs_north[, PBS_north_hot := (T_hot_amb + T_hot_pre - T_amb_pre) / 2]

# Optional: drop T columns if you don't need them
pbs_north[, c("T_hot_amb", "T_hot_pre", "T_amb_pre") := NULL]

# Remove negatives and NAs
pbs_north[Fst_hot_amb < 0 | is.na(Fst_hot_amb), Fst_hot_amb := 0]
pbs_north[Fst_hot_pre < 0 | is.na(Fst_hot_pre), Fst_hot_pre := 0]
pbs_north[Fst_amb_pre < 0 | is.na(Fst_amb_pre), Fst_amb_pre := 0]

# Calculate T distances
pbs_north[, T_hot_amb := -log(1 - Fst_hot_amb)]
pbs_north[, T_hot_pre := -log(1 - Fst_hot_pre)]
pbs_north[, T_amb_pre := -log(1 - Fst_amb_pre)]

# Final PBS
pbs_north[, PBS_north_hot := (T_hot_amb + T_hot_pre - T_amb_pre) / 2]

# Optional: remove intermediate T columns
pbs_north[, c("T_hot_amb", "T_hot_pre", "T_amb_pre") := NULL]

pbs_north <- pbs_north |> mutate(region = "north")

pbs_north <- pbs_north |> dplyr::rename(PBS = PBS_north_hot)
```

```{r}
pbs<- rbind(pbs_central, pbs_hybrid, pbs_north)
pos<- read.table("/Users/alexmacadam/Desktop/pbs/aten_larvae_pos.txt", header = T)

pbs2<- left_join(pbs, pos, by = c("POS","CHROM"))

#change Inf to relevant values
finite_max <- max(pbs2$PBS[is.finite(pbs2$PBS)])
pbs2$PBS[pbs2$PBS == Inf] <- finite_max + 1e-6

#change Inf to relevant values
finite_min <- min(pbs2$PBS[is.finite(pbs2$PBS)])
pbs2$PBS[pbs2$PBS == -Inf] <- finite_min - 1e-6

# Compute empirical p-values
pbs <- pbs2$PBS
pbs2$pval <- rank(-pbs, ties.method = "first") / length(pbs)
pbs2$padj <- p.adjust(pbs2$pval, method = "BH")
```

```{r}
#top and bottom 1%
thr_high <- quantile(pbs2$PBS, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
thr_low  <- quantile(pbs2$PBS, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

top_hits    <- subset(pbs2, PBS >= thr_high)
bottom_hits <- subset(pbs2, PBS <= thr_low)
```

```{r}
cols<- c("#277da1","#f94144","#43aa8b")

pbs2 |> ggplot() +
  geom_violin(aes(x = region, y = PBS, fill = region)) +
    theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cols) +
  labs(x="PBS", y="Density") +
  ylim(-0.05, 0.05)

pbs2 |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(PBS, fill = region)) +
  facet_wrap(~region, nrow = 1) +  
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cols) +
  labs(x="PBS", y="Density")
```

```{r}
# Perform pairwise Wilcoxon tests by metric × temperature
pbs2 |> rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(PBS ~ region, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```

```{r}
library(effsize)

# Make sure PBS is numeric
pbs2$PBS <- as.numeric(pbs2$PBS)

#north hybrids
# Keep only north + hybrid
pbs_nor_hyb <- subset(pbs2, region %in% c("north", "hybrid"))

# Drop NA, NaN, and Inf in PBS explicitly
pbs_nor_hyb <- pbs_nor_hyb[is.finite(pbs_nor_hyb$PBS), ]

# Make region a factor (after subsetting)
pbs_nor_hyb$region <- factor(pbs_nor_hyb$region)

# sanity check:
any(!is.finite(pbs_nor_hyb$PBS))  # should return FALSE
summary(pbs_nor_hyb$PBS)
table(pbs_nor_hyb$region)

# Choose reference level if you care (optional)
pbs_nor_hyb$region <- relevel(pbs_nor_hyb$region, ref = "north")

nor_hyb_wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(PBS ~ region, data = pbs_nor_hyb)
nor_hyb_wilcox_result

cohen.d(PBS ~ region, data = pbs_nor_hyb)
cliff.delta(PBS ~ region, data = pbs_nor_hyb)
```

```{r}
# Remove NA, NaN, Inf
pbs_clean <- pbs2[is.finite(pbs2$PBS), ]

pbs_means <- pbs_clean %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_PBS = mean(PBS, na.rm = TRUE))
pbs_means

# Get means as named vectors
means <- tapply(pbs_clean$PBS, pbs_clean$region, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
means

# Calculate % differences
pct_hybrid_vs_north   <- (means["hybrid"]  - means["north"])  / means["north"]  * 100
pct_hybrid_vs_central <- (means["hybrid"]  - means["central"]) / means["central"] * 100
pct_north_vs_central  <- (means["north"]   - means["central"]) / means["central"] * 100

pct_hybrid_vs_north
pct_hybrid_vs_central
pct_north_vs_central
```
